suggested_experiment_name: FUNK (Fundament Universality and Kinetic mixing eXperiment)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter χ (dimensionless), plotted as lg χ on y-axis
notes: Funk experiment searches for hidden-photon dark matter using a large spherical mirror (14.56 m²) with a PMT detector. The limit χ ≲ 6.65×10⁻¹³ at 95% C.L. is derived for the mass range 1.95 < m_γ' / eV < 8.55 (corresponding to visible and near-UV wavelengths 150–630 nm). The paper assumes hidden photons comprise all of the cold dark matter with local density ρ_CDM = 0.3 GeV/cm³. The measurement was conducted over ~27.5 days in 2019. The limit is presented as a horizontal line (mass-independent within the stated range) because the experimental sensitivity is determined by the detector's wavelength range rather than mass-dependent physics. The paper reports no significant signal above background (Δr_open = −0.0229 ± 0.0108 Hz) and applies the Feldman-Cousins prescription to derive the upper limit.
